features.apple: MainMenu.nib Edit > Copy, Select All; Tools > Text Selection
features.note: Edit > Copy copies the picture selection as an image or the whole shown PDF page text; Select All selects the page. No selection of text ranges within a page: the PDF text extractor reports lines without positions. Not yet checked on the lab machine.
Tools > Rectangular Selection and Crop (Cmd+K) for pictures, with marks moved into the cropped page and Undo. PDF crop box is not written. Not yet checked on the lab machine.

features.feature: Find in PDF with results sidebar
features.apple: MainMenu.nib Edit > Find, Find Next/Previous; PVSearchPanel.nib, PVSidebarSearchResults.nib
features.note: Find, Find Next and Find Previous; hits listed in the Search Results sidebar. The status line takes the query (no toolbar search field) and hits are not highlighted on the page because the extractor gives no glyph positions. Not yet checked on the lab machine.

features.feature: Zoom in/out, Actual Size, Zoom to Fit
features.apple: MainMenu.nib View > Zoom In/Out, Actual Size, Zoom to Fit

features.note: View > Zoom to Selection fills the window with the selection (model::zoom_to_rect, tested). Not yet checked on the lab machine.

features.wire: Enable Rotate for PDF pages by calling Document::set_turn for the current page

features.note: Tools > Flip Horizontal/Vertical for pictures and PDF pages as shown, in exports and picture saves; mirroring is not written into a saved PDF. Not yet checked on the lab machine.
Tools > Adjust Size takes a width, a height or both in the status line and resamples the picture (undoable). No sheet or unit choice. Not yet checked on the lab machine.
Adjust Color panel (Cmd+Option+C) with sliders for exposure, contrast, saturation, temperature and midtones. No sharpness, levels or histogram. Not yet checked on the lab machine.
Tools > Remove Background clears the regions that touch the corners and match their colour (flood fill, not a segmentation model). Not yet checked on the lab machine.
Tools > Instant Alpha clears the connected region of the clicked colour (tolerance fixed). Drag-to-grow selection is not done. Not yet checked on the lab machine.

features.apple: MainMenu.nib Tools > Annotate (Rectangle, Oval, Line, Arrow, Star, Polygon, Speech Bubble, Note)
features.note: Annotate adds Oval, Line, Arrow, Star and Speech Bubble beside Highlight, Note, Rectangle and Rounded; all are drawn, burned into exports and written as PDF annotations. Polygon is not done. Not yet checked on the lab machine.

features.apple: MainMenu.nib Tools > Annotate > Underline/Strike Through Text
features.note: Underline and Strike Through are dragged over the text as rectangles and saved as Underline and StrikeOut annotations; they do not snap to text because the extractor gives no positions. Not yet checked on the lab machine.

Tools > Annotate > Text places a box and takes typed text; saved as a FreeText annotation in Helvetica 12. No font, size or colour choice and the text is not burned into picture exports. Not yet checked on the lab machine.
Strokes drawn with the Sign tool are kept in a library (six entries) and Tools > Signatures places one on the shown page. No camera or trackpad capture sheet. Not yet checked on the lab machine.

Tools > Redact draws a solid black box; it is burned into pictures. In a PDF the box covers the page but the text beneath stays in the file (Save says so). True content removal needs a content stream rewriter. Not yet checked on the lab machine.

features.feature: Inspector (file info, metadata, keywords, annotations, encryption)
features.note: Inspector panel (Cmd+I): name, kind, size, dimensions, pages, PDF version, encryption, annotation and bookmark counts, location. No keywords or document metadata editing. Not yet checked on the lab machine.
Tools > Show Magnifier draws a 2x lens of the drawn picture at the pointer; it follows the pointer while it moves over the window. Not yet checked on the lab machine.
Reads the GPS latitude and longitude from a JPEG Exif block (tested with a built block) and shows them in the Inspector. No map. Not yet checked on the lab machine.
